informal_statement: In a matroid, the union of two disjoint circuits is either dependent or empty.

id.name: Matroid.IsUnionDisjointCircuits.dep_or_empty
id.content:
/-- Union of disjoint circuits is either dependent or empty. -/
lemma Matroid.IsUnionDisjointCircuits.dep_or_empty {M : Matroid α} {X : Set α} (hMX : M.IsUnionDisjointCircuits X) :
    M.Dep X ∨ X = ∅ :=
  have ⟨F, hXF⟩ := hMX
  hXF ▸ F.dep_or_empty

and predicates.

rag.content:
theorem disjoint_finset_sum_left {β : Type*} {i : Finset β} {f : β → Multiset α} {a : Multiset α} :
    Disjoint (i.sum f) a ↔ ∀ b ∈ i, Disjoint (f b) a := by
  convert @disjoint_sum_left _ a (map f i.val)
  simp [and_congr_left_iff]

informal_statement: The empty set is disjoint from the union of any collection of circuits in a matroid.
informal_proof:
Since the empty set contains no elements, it is automatically disjoint from any other set, including the union of circuits.
Additionally, because the empty set does not contain any elements, its union with any collection of circuits remains disjoint.
Thus, the empty set satisfies the condition of being disjoint from the union of circuits in a matroid.
